symptom: `toString($User/id)`, `$A/id = $B/id`, `$User/Bogus` in a microflow expression passed `check -p --references` (and the type pass's 'Expression types OK') and exec; mx check CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." (mendixlabs/mxcli#1650)
cause: Nothing resolved the member steps of an expression's `$Var/...` path against the variable's entity: the expression type checker infers KindUnknown for an attribute it cannot find and stays silent, and the reference pass only judged CREATE/CHANGE members
insight: Put it in the reference pass, not the type pass: exec's preflight runs ValidateProgramWithWarnings, not TypeCheckProgram, so only the former gives check and exec one verdict. Measured on 11.13.0 in an app with no other error (one CE1613 elsewhere suppressed all twelve CE0117s): CE0117 for `id` in any case, a wrong-case attribute, a capitalised `CreatedDate`, `changedDate` the root does not store, bare `owner`, a BARE association (`$O/Ord_Cust/Name`), a missing association, and a missing attribute after a hop; clean for inherited members incl. System.User's and `createdDate` on a specialization whose root stores it. Collect paths by reflecting over each statement's fields (skipping nested bodies, which the typed walk visits with their own scope, a retrieve's XPath and a feedback target) rather than a hand-kept switch of statement kinds. System.User is readable from the project here (modelsdk backend), so `$User/Bogus` is judged
fix: check --references (and so exec's preflight) reports a `$Var/<member>` step that is not an attribute of the entity or its generalizations, a bare association, a missing association or one the entity is no end of; `id` gets the CommunityCommons.getGUID / compare-the-objects hint
